richiami.difetto: Due to poor maintenance of the coolant the heater matrix may leak coolant into the air bag computer.  The water ingress could cause a short circuit which in the worst case could cause the air bag to deploy.
richiami.rimedio: Installation of a shield to protect the ECU from leaking coolant. If the heater matrix shows signs of corrosion then this will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: AIR BAG MAY DEPLOY WITHOUT WARNING

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that a check valve within the fuel evaporative control system may develop a crack from long term use. In the worst case leakage of fuel evaporative gas vapour into the vehicle interior may occur resulting in the potential of fire in the presence of an ignition source.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the subject check valve replaced.

richiami.difetto: The product poses a risk of fire and a chemical risk because a crack may occur in the ventilation valve of the fuel vapour recirculation system after an extensive operating period and fuel vapour can enter the interior of the vehicle.One incident reported involving fire.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective actions taken by the manufacturer. · Date of entry into force: Unknown

richiami.difetto: The product poses a serious risk of injuries because in the universal joint which connects the steering shaft and the gear box, there are tightening bolts that may not have been sufficiently tightened. In such a case, the connecting area concerned may loosen while steering operation is done in stationary state. If a vehicle is used continually in such a condition, abnormal noise may emanate, and in the worst case the connecting area may be possibly detached, leading to eventual loss of steering control.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: Type M4, EG- type approval e13*2001/116*0198.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary corrective action taken by the importer. · Date of entry into force: Unknown

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that failure of the propshaft universal joint may occur which can cause the propshaft to detach. On van versions the propshaft may contact the fuel tank and or the fuel lines.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will be fitted with a quality assured propshaft.

richiami.difetto: Improper torque control has led to the possibility that the front hub nuts could become loose and cause vibration.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and check the hub nut torque. Additionally any worn or damaged components will be changed.
richiami.titolo: FRONT HUB NUTS MAY BE INCORRECTLY TORQUED AND COME LOOSE.

richiami.difetto: Corrosion of the top of the fuel tank may result in a fuel oil leak.
richiami.titolo: CORROSION OF FUEL TANK MAY LEAD TO FUEL LEAK

richiami.difetto: Corrosion of the top of the fuel tank may result in a fuel leak.
richiami.titolo: CORROSION OF FUEL TANK MAY LEAD TO FUEL LEAK

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the headlight and horn wiring circuit may fail resulting in the unexpected failure of the headlights and horn.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely affected vehicles for modifications to the headlight and horn circuit wiring connection.

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the headlight and horn wiring circuit may fail resulting in the unexpected failure of the headlights and horn.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely affected vehicles for modifications to the headlight and horn circuit wiring connection.

richiami.difetto: The fuel tank could suffer from external corrosion in service and may become porous with the result that the tank could leak fuel.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the fuel tank with a quality assured unit

richiami.difetto: The terminal blades of some wiring harness connectors may corrode resulting in a failure of electrical power supply.
richiami.rimedio: The affected vehicles are being recalled for replacement and modification of the relevant wiring harnesses. The replacements will incorporate moisture proof connectors.

richiami.difetto: The nut securing the brake pedal may not have been tightened to the specified torque. If this is not corrected it could allow detachment of the pedal.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles remove the relevant nut apply locking compound to the threads and replace and tighten the nut to the manufacturers specified torque.
